mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 9.0% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 9.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 1.0% from prior month indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS rise by more than 1.0% in the prior month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 signals supply chain disruption, reducing output and increasing inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 90.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100k and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 0.2pp indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises by more than 100k and UNRATE falls by more than 0.2pp in the prior month, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
